name: North Algeria Fire Risk Model
description: XGBoost classifier predicting daily wildfire occurrence (fire_occurred) per 0.5x0.625 deg grid cell in northern Algeria, trained on VIIRS fire detections (2020-2026) and NASA POWER daily climate data.

notes: doy_sin/doy_cos are cyclic encodings of DOY: sin(2*pi*DOY/365.25), cos(2*pi*DOY/365.25)
scale_pos_weight used to handle class imbalance = neg/pos in training set
fire-derived columns (fire_count, frp_*, brightness_*) were excluded as features to avoid target leakage
